summary: Tested the Near me -> city picker change on the preview (Ottawa host). Unit tests 49/49 pass; tests/test_rev3_api.py 22/22 pass. UI (Playwright + curl): no Near me button; the form has place-input (prefilled 'Ottawa', datalist of 515 cities), distance/program selects (they no longer auto-submit: the URL stays the same after a change) and Apply. 'Kitchener, ON' + 100 km + Apply -> 'Courses near Kitchener, ON', subheading 'within 100 km', first card Kitchener Central 2 km away. The place cookie persists across reload. 'montreal' -> 'Montréal, QC'. 'Atlantis' -> notice-place_not_found + Ottawa courses. 'Ottawa' -> 'Courses in and around Ottawa'. The online tab shows 'Organiser near Kitchener, ON' badges first. The program filter works after Apply. FR: Ville/Distance/Programme/Appliquer and a French not-found notice. Footer GeoNames credit is on the server-rendered pages and the SPA, with no DB-IP text anywhere. Privacy has a 'Your city' section. /admin/insights loads for the admin ticket. Without a cookie, the shared link opens expanded with calendar/share/remind. 2 bugs: (1) the URL still contains an empty 'program=' after Apply; (2) a shared course link opened by a visitor whose place cookie is another city shows course_missing.

minor.issue: The shared course is looked up only within the visitor's chosen place area. With the cookie place='Kitchener, ON', /?course=1731160 (an Ottawa course) shows notice-course_missing and does not open the course. Repro: curl -b 'place=Kitchener, ON' <preview>/?course=1731160. Fix: when ?course is given, fall back to the site's own city area (or search all courses) if it is not found in the chosen area.

Picking 'Ottawa, ON' from the datalist gives 'Courses near Ottawa, ON' (and stores that cookie) instead of 'Courses in and around Ottawa'. _norm(text) is compared only with displayName 'Ottawa', not with the matched place. Compare the found place to the site city, e.g. by label or name/coords.
'Kitchener ON' / 'kitchener on' (no comma) is not found, so the place_not_found notice shows. _norm keeps the comma as a token. Consider removing commas when building the key.

ui_bugs.issue: The URL includes an empty program= (e.g. /?tab=newcomer&place=Kitchener%2C+ON&km=100&program=), which the review request says must not happen. site.js only disables empty selects in the old [data-autosubmit] change handler, and no element has that attribute any more. Fix: add a submit handler for [data-testid=course-filters] (or a data attribute) that disables empty selects before submit, or leave out the name on the 'All programs' option.

issues: The city input (min-width 220px) and the selects don't fill the row, so the controls look ragged. Consider width:100% on small screens.
'voici les cours près de Ottawa': French elision would give 'près d'Ottawa' (cosmetic).

action_items: Drop the empty program= on Apply (submit handler that disables empty selects, or similar)
Shared link /?course=<id>: also search the site's own area (or all courses) when the visitor's chosen place does not contain the course
Treat 'Ottawa, ON' (the site's own city picked from the datalist) as the home city
Optional: match 'Kitchener ON' without a comma; full-width controls on mobile
critical_code_review_comments: home_view.build_view: the course lookup uses the place-adjusted area, so shared links break for visitors with a different city cookie.
home_view.build_view: the home-city check compares the typed text only with displayName, so the datalist label for the home city counts as a different place.
site.js: the data-autosubmit handler is now dead code, and the empty-select cleanup is lost with it.
A failed place lookup resets the place cookie to '' (fine, but the user's previous city is lost).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (empty program= in URL; shared link with another city's cookie)

seed_data_creation: None. Did not touch the admin config. Test traffic added insight_events/access_logs (TTL).
